<!-- EN -->
  ## ✨ Features
  - Added customizable gesture zone width (8–32 dp) and proportion controls for more precise edge gesture positioning
  - Added support for triggering edge gestures on the lock screen; actions requiring an unlocked device are
  automatically executed after unlocking

  ## 🔧 Fixes & Improvements
  - Restored automatic and manual update checks with a new Compose update dialog, localized release notes, and direct
  access to the release page
  - Improved Edge Lighting to trigger only for heads-up notifications and prevent repeated lighting from in-place
  notification updates
  - Improved Premium activation reliability by retrying the Keystore verification challenge after configuration and
  status broadcasts

  <!-- ZH -->
  ## ✨ 新功能
  - 新增手势区域自定义功能，支持调整区域宽度（8–32 dp）和所占比例，实现更精确的边缘手势布局
  - 新增锁屏界面手势触发支持；需要解锁的动作将在设备解锁后自动执行

  ## 🔧 修复与优化
  - 恢复自动及手动更新检查，并新增 Compose 更新弹窗、本地化更新说明和发布页面入口
  - 优化边缘闪光，仅在通知显示悬浮提醒时触发，并避免通知原地更新导致重复闪光

- Added "Fast Scroll" action with options to scroll to the top or bottom of the screen               
- Improved Edge Lighting notification lifecycle and deduplication logic to prevent redundant lighting triggers

- Restored the haptic feedback type selection (allowing choices between click, tick, heavy click, and double click)
- Fixed the condition picker sheet list layout to be scrollable and fully visible

## 📥 Download

 ## ✨ 新功能

changelog.name: v2.0.0
changelog.body:
<!-- EN -->
# 🎉 Welcome to EdgeX 2.0.0!
  This release marks a major milestone as we have **fully migrated the configuration UI to Jetpack Compose**, bringing a highly unified modern aesthetic, dynamic themes, and intuitive preview-style settings.

  ## ✨ Features

  - **Jetpack Compose UI Rewrite**: Fully migrated and redesigned the configuration interface using Jetpack Compose, featuring a highly unified
modern aesthetic and smooth transitions
  - Preview-Style Configuration Pages: Redesigned the configuration screens for Pie menu, Custom panel, and Side bar to offer real-time
      preview layouts, making customization highly intuitive (what you see is what you get)
  - Added support for 3-state Dark Mode (Follow System, Light, Dark) across the Compose app and system overlays
  - Redesigned the App Freezer drawer with a transparent, premium glassmorphism frosted styling
  - Redesigned the Action Selection Sheet and Gesture/Key triggers list using Jetpack Compose
  - Added dynamic indicators showing the count of enabled zones and hardware keys on the Compose Home screen tiles
  - Added dynamic action icons and target app icons in the hardware key remapping triggers list
  - Improved theme settings with instant, dynamic application of custom accent colors in the Compose layout

  ## 🔧 Fixes & Improvements

  - Fixed gesture and key action labels in the Compose UI not dynamically updating when switching system language
  - Fixed layout clipping and text wrapping issues in Compose components for English locales (e.g. Edge Lighting subtitle)
  - Fixed background coverage and clipping issues for app icons in the Freezer drawer
  - Added missing Chinese translation resources for Flashlight, Game Mode, and Partial Screenshot actions

  ## 📥 Download

  - [GitHub](https://github.com/fcmfcm1999/EdgeX/releases/latest)


<!-- ZH -->

本次更新迎来了里程碑式的重构，**配置界面全面迁移至 Jetpack Compose**。不仅带来了更加精致统一的现代视觉设计，还支持动态强调色以及直观的“所见即所得”预览配置。

  ## ✨ 新功能

  - **Jetpack Compose 界面重构**：配置界面全面使用 Jetpack Compose 进行重构与升级，带来高度一致的现代美学设计与流畅的交互动效

  - 全面支持三态深色模式切换（跟随系统、浅色、深色），Compose 配置界面与系统层悬浮窗无缝统一

changelog.name: v1.3.0
changelog.body:
<!-- EN -->                                                                                               
  ## ✨ Features  

  - **Freezer drawer redesign**: Material You aesthetics, improved portrait/landscape layout with more columns and cleaner card style                                                                            
  - **Clipboard action**: new action type to paste clipboard content
  - **Haptic feedback**: optional haptic feedback for edge gestures (Advanced Options)                      
                                                                                                            
  ## 🔧 Fix & Improve  

  - **All hooks now run entirely in `system_server`**: removed the SystemUI process dependency — the module no longer requires the EdgeX app to be running in the background to function (shell command actions are the only exception)
  - **Hook config persistence**: config snapshot is cached in device storage and refreshed on boot, so settings survive without the app process staying alive                                                    
  - **Shell command reliability**: shell actions are dispatched to the app process via an AIDL-bound service, which reliably wakes a stopped process on Android 15                                             
  - **Drawer rotation fix**: drawer layout now redraws correctly on screen rotation
  - **Xposed scope cleaned up — `system` entry removed, only `android` is required**                     
  - **License changed to GPLv3** (previously MIT)
                                                                                                            
  <!-- ZH -->                                               
  ## ✨ 新功能 
                                                                                         
  - **冻结抽屉重设计**：采用 Material You 风格，竖屏列数增加，卡片样式更简洁，横屏布局优化
  - **剪贴板动作**：新增粘贴剪贴板内容的动作类型                                                            
  - **触觉反馈**：在高级选项中可开启边缘手势的震动反馈
                                                                                                            
  ## 🔧 修复与优化 
                                     
  - **所有 Hook 逻辑统一在 `system_server` 中运行**：移除了对 SystemUI 进程的依赖——除 Shell命令动作外，模块不再依赖 EdgeX 应用本身常驻后台即可正常工作                                               
  - **Hook 配置持久化**：配置快照缓存至设备存储并在开机后自动刷新，设置无需应用进程保持存活即可生效
  - **Shell 命令执行可靠性提升**：Shell 动作通过 AIDL 绑定服务分发到应用进程执行，在 Android 15上可可靠唤醒已停止的应用进程                                                                              
  - **修复横竖屏切换时抽屉不刷新的问题**                                                                    
  - **Xposed 作用域精简，移除多余的 `system` 条目，仅需 `android`**                                  
  - **开源协议变更为 GPLv3**（原为 MIT）

changelog.name: v1.2.3
changelog.body:
✨ 主要更新特性
主题系统：实现全新的主题管理系统，支持品牌色自定义、RGB 实时预览及 UI 组件适配。
手势引擎重构：将手势管理模块化，拆分检测器、分发器与状态管理，显著提升系统稳定性。
延迟决策算法：引入手势延迟决策逻辑，支持长按操作，并优化了与原生系统交互的响应性。
🐛 核心修复与优化
复制模式优化：全局复制模式激活时自动禁用边缘手势，避免操作冲突。
系统兼容性：优化系统返回手势的禁用逻辑，仅在配置了对应滑动动作时才干预系统行为。
持久化配置：将应用冻结列表迁移至持久化配置，提升数据可靠性。
事件注入修复：修正手势透传至原生系统时的触摸事件 (Final Touch Event) 注入问题，解决点击失效 bug。

readme:
# EdgeX

[English](./README_EN.md)

## 简介

EdgeX 是一个面向 Android 15+ 的 LSPosed/Xposed 模块，目标是把边缘手势、按键动作、冻结应用抽屉和一些高频系统操作整合到一起，向 Xposed Edge 致敬。

目前已实现的功能包括：

- 16 个边缘触发区域：左/右/上/下四边均支持三段细分区域，并提供整条边缘的低优先级兜底区域。
- 每个区域可分别配置单击、双击、长按，以及符合边缘方向的滑动手势。
- 支持子手势：可在主手势后继续配置停留、二段上/下/左/右滑动等链式动作。
- 硬件按键动作：支持音量上、音量下、电源键的单击、双击、长按。
- 可分配动作包括：返回、主页、多任务、展开通知栏、锁屏、截图、全局复制、粘贴剪贴板、杀死前台应用、清理后台应用、亮度调节、音量调节、启动指定应用、启动应用快捷方式、音乐控制、自定义 Shell 命令。
- Freezer 功能：冻结/解冻应用、保存冻结列表、从手势或按键呼出 Freezer Drawer（Material You 风格），并支持一键重新冻结。
- 提供主题配色、自定义 RGB、手势调试区域显示、触发震动反馈、动作图标、更新检查等附加功能。

使用前请注意：

- 模块目前以 Android 15+ 为目标。
- LSPosed/Xposed 作用域只需勾选 `android`（System Framework）。
- Freezer、清理后台、部分快捷方式读取和部分 Shell 命令依赖 root 权限或系统级 Hook 能力。
